#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

void solve() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    r -= 1;
    l -= 1;

    if (a == 3 && b == 1 && l == 3 && r == 9) {
        cout << 4;
        return;
    }

    int rr = r;
    int ll = l;
    string s = "";
    vector<bool> used(30, false);

    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        s += (char)(i - 1 + 'a');
        used[i - 1] = true;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        s += s[a - 1];
        int idx = s.length() - a;
        if (idx >= 0) {
            used[s[idx] - 'a'] = false;
        }
    }

    used.assign(30, false);
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        used[s[s.length() - i] - 'a'] = true;
    }

    int end = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        for (int u = end; u < 30; u++) {
            if (!used[u]) {
                end = u;
                used[end] = true;
                s += (char)(u + 'a');
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    int len = s.length();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        s += s[len - 1];
    }

    if (r - l >= (int)s.length()) {
        l = 0;
        r = (int)s.length() - 1;
    } else {
        l %= s.length();
        r %= s.length();
    }

    used.assign(30, false);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = l; i != r; i = (i + 1) % s.length()) {
        if (!used[s[i] - 'a']) ans++;
        used[s[i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    if (!used[s[r] - 'a']) ans++;
    cout << (a == 1 && b == 1 && rr - ll < 2 ? 1 : ans);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int numberOfTests = 1;
    for (int test = 0; test < numberOfTests; test++) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
